merge nearby silences merged=[] for s,e in silences:     if not merged:         merged.append([s,e])         continue     ps,pe=merged[-1]     if s<=pe+MERGE_GAP:         merged[-1][1]=max(pe,e)     else:         merged.append([s,e])  #
